title: Vote: default value expressions for V4
summary: danielcweeks started a vote on adding default value expressions, as proposed in an earlier discuss thread. The change expands write-default in V4 so that it can hold an expression as defined by the expressions spec, not only a literal. The vote message links the discuss thread, the proposal document and spec PR #16777, and asks for votes within 72 hours. The ballot options in the message are worded as adding stats-only fields to the table spec, although the subject and description are about default value expressions. All replies were +1 votes; pvary and GGraziadei said they had left minor comments. On 6 November danielcweeks thanked voters, said he would add his own +1 and close the vote with a separate result thread. One further +1 arrived afterwards. The result itself is not stated in this thread.

positions.stance: Expand write-default in V4 to allow expressions defined by the expressions spec.

outcome.note: No result is stated in this thread; the caller said he would close it with a separate result thread. The thread shows only +1 votes: 8 marked binding, 8 marked non-binding and 2 unmarked, plus the caller's own announced +1.

why_it_matters: If adopted, V4 column defaults can be expressions rather than only literals, which writers will have to evaluate.
